name: Sana Ahmed
title: Senior Luxury Property Advisor
bio: Sana brings over 15 years of experience in Pakistan's luxury property market, specializing in high-end villas and estates across Karachi and Lahore.

reviews.author: Ayesha K.
reviews.text: Sana made the entire buying process effortless and understood exactly what our family needed.

reviews.author: Usman P.
reviews.text: Professional, responsive, and deeply knowledgeable about the Karachi market.

name: Hamza Qureshi
title: Residential Investment Advisor
bio: Hamza combines a finance background with deep knowledge of Lahore residential investments, helping clients assess value, documentation, and long-term potential.

reviews.author: Bilal R.
reviews.text: Hamza negotiated an excellent deal and his financial analysis gave us confidence in the purchase.

name: Mariam Khan
title: Urban Property Expert
bio: Mariam specializes in urban residences and premium plots in Gulberg. She helps buyers navigate Lahore's competitive central market with clarity.

reviews.author: Danish T.
reviews.text: Mariam found us the perfect home in Gulberg and understood our budget perfectly.

name: Faisal Shah
title: Estate & Land Specialist
bio: Faisal focuses on farmhouse estates and land acquisitions around Islamabad. His understanding of documentation makes him a trusted advisor for families and investors.

reviews.author: Farah B.
reviews.text: Faisal helped us find the perfect farmhouse estate and handled the process with great care.
